harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Published node2's port-8080 app through node1 to node3 via a new private link plus VyOS DNAT/SNAT, without exposing the rest of node1↔node2's private network. All three nodes were then restarted one at a time with verified boot-identity change and full post-restart recovery.
actions_performed: Discovered topology: node1/node2/node3 share a common /24 (10.100.249.0/24) via eth0; node1 and node2 each also have an unconfigured eth1 for a dedicated private link.
Configured a new private subnet 10.50.50.0/24 on node1 eth1 (10.50.50.254/24, VyOS) and node2 eth1 (10.50.50.10/24, via nmcli static connection so it survives reconciliation/reboot).

Deployed a systemd-managed python http.server demo app on node2:8080 (enabled+started), and restricted it in firewalld to only accept from the 10.50.50.0/24 private subnet (blocking direct access from node3 over the shared eth0 network).

Configured VyOS on node1: nat destination rule 10 (DNAT eth0:8080 -> 10.50.50.10:8080), firewall ipv4 forward filter default-drop with rule 5 (established/related) and rule 10 (allow eth0->eth1 tcp/8080 to 10.50.50.10), and nat source rule 10 (masquerade for eth1-outbound traffic destined to 10.50.50.10:8080) to fix asymmetric-routing hairpin caused by node2's direct L2 path back to node3.
Verified node3 can reach the app only via node1:8080, and cannot reach node2 directly on 8080, cannot reach node2's private IP, and cannot reach unrelated ports (22) via node1.

Captured pre-restart boot_id and health baselines on all 3 nodes, then restarted node1, node2, and node3 sequentially (one at a time) using native `reboot`, polled each until exec was available again, confirmed changed boot_id, and re-verified config persistence, service health, and end-to-end port-forward functionality plus continued isolation after each restart.

evidence.requirement: Baseline private network + app setup and connectivity between node1 and node2
evidence.summary: Discovered topology (shared /24 + unconfigured eth1 on node1/node2), configured static 10.50.50.0/24 private link, deployed demo app on node2:8080, and confirmed node1 can reach node2 over the private link.

evidence.requirement: App restricted to the private network (not directly exposed to node3)
evidence.summary: firewalld rich rule limits node2:8080 to 10.50.50.0/24 source; node3 confirmed unable to reach node2 directly via eth0 or via the private subnet, both before and after configuring the forward.

evidence.requirement: Publish app through node1 to node3 on port 8080 (VyOS DNAT/SNAT + forward firewall)
evidence.summary: Configured and iteratively fixed VyOS DNAT, forward-filter established/related state, and masquerade SNAT to resolve asymmetric routing; node3 successfully retrieves the app content via node1:8080 (HTTP 200).

evidence.requirement: Rest of private network stays closed to node3 after publishing
evidence.summary: node3 cannot reach node2 directly (8080), node2's private IP, or node1's SSH port — only the forwarded 8080 path works.

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 7668189d... and NAT config captured; reboot acked; boot_id changed to eb0becc7...; VyOS config/forwarding persisted and end-to-end app access via node3 confirmed post-restart.

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 8c28f3cd... and app health captured; reboot acked; boot_id changed to 4124fbb2...; eth1 static IP, firewalld rule, and demo-app.service persisted, app reachable via node1 post-restart.

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id e65e6bcf... and app reachability captured; reboot acked; boot_id changed to 6f92ff83...; app access via node1:8080 and continued isolation confirmed post-restart.

attempts.summary: Published node2's port-8080 app through node1 to node3 via a new private link plus VyOS DNAT/SNAT, without exposing the rest of node1↔node2's private network. All three nodes were then restarted one at a time with verified boot-identity change and full post-restart recovery.
